qualification: Pre-fix RootMp4Reader and OwnedMp4Reader accepted empty elst boxes (entry_count == 0) and zero-duration elst entries (segment_duration == 0), AudioTimeline::new accepted zero-duration audio edits producing 0-sample schedules, and owned_video_timeline::map_edits skipped leading media_time < 0 edits and returned Ok(vec![]) on blank-only edit lists, causing NativeReader and decode_video to ignore the edit list and play all 3 unedited frames. Pre-fix baseline reproduced all defects and the forced acceptance test failed.

Updating src/container/mp4.rs, crates/fvid-media/src/owned_mp4_impl.rs, crates/fvid-media/src/owned_mp4_audio_schedule_impl.rs, and crates/fvid-media/src/owned_video_timeline.rs rejects empty elst boxes, zero-duration v0/v1 edit entries, zero-duration audio timeline segments, and blank-only video playback edit lists as Error::Invalid.

Both healthy edited controls (v0 leading empty delay + media edit and v1 single-segment trim) preserve exact video frame counts (2 frames), probe_mp4 durations, seek/rewind, and analytical AAC-LC float32 PCM (3,072 samples with 1,024 leading silence samples and 2,048 trimmed samples respectively) within 1e-7, while all 4 malformed edit-list fixtures refuse cleanly as Error::Invalid.
4 focused tests, 51 related MP4/AAC integration tests, 6 video/audio timeline unit tests, 23 minimal-configuration (--no-default-features) tests, offline fixture unittest, and full player build pass.

ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015, 8.6.5 (EditBox) and 8.6.6 (EditListBox) govern elst entry counts, segment durations, and empty-edit semantics. All fixtures are pure synthetic offline VP9/AAC-LC MP4 files requiring neither FFmpeg nor network access.
counting: One MP4/MOV elst edit-list validation and blank-only edit refusal fix across container and timeline layers (FVID-0187). No extra IDs for individual fixture variants or controls.
